evidence.reason: At line 577, noteAddressTerminalBookkeeping overwrites the single session.bookkeeping map with entries for whatever root called it, even though the same session state is keyed by root for verifiedHeads (lines 564-567). A session that records bookkeeping for two checkout roots therefore loses the first root's entries, so later settlement for that root cannot find its own bookkeeping digest. The root argument is used only to obtain the session, not to partition the stored entries.
